to부정사.s: <보기> She went to the library <u>to borrow</u> some books.
to부정사.q: 밑줄 친 to부정사의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
o: He has a lot of homework <u>to do</u>.
We got up early <u>to see</u> the sunrise.
It is important <u>to exercise</u> every day.
to부정사.x: <보기>·③ 목적(~하기 위해) / ① 명사적(목적어) ② 형용사적(homework 수식) ④ 명사적(주어) ⑤ 진주어

to부정사.s: <보기> I was surprised <u>to hear</u> the news.
to부정사.q: 밑줄 친 to부정사의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
o: She studied hard <u>to pass</u> the test.
They were glad <u>to meet</u> their teacher.
My plan is <u>to travel</u> to Jeju.
The boy grew up <u>to be</u> a pilot.
to부정사.x: <보기>·② 감정(surprised · glad) 뒤 → 감정의 원인 '~해서' / ① 목적 ③ 보어 ④ 형용사적 ⑤ 결과

to부정사.q: 밑줄 친 to부정사의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
o: The river is dangerous <u>to swim</u> in.
It is hard <u>to answer</u> this question.
He was sad <u>to lose</u> the game.
I need a pen <u>to write</u> with.
to부정사.x: <보기>·① 형용사(hard · dangerous)를 꾸밈 '~하기에' / ② 가주어 It의 진주어 ③ 감정의 원인 ④ 형용사적 ⑤ 목적

to부정사.s: <보기> He grew up <u>to be</u> a famous singer.
to부정사.q: 밑줄 친 to부정사의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
to부정사.x: <보기>·① 결과 '(자라서 / 살아서) ~가 되었다' / ② 목적 ③ 형용사적 ④ 감정의 원인 ⑤ 명사적

to부정사.s: 밑줄 친 to부정사의 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
o: I got up early <u>to catch</u> the first bus.
He saved money <u>to buy</u> a bike.
Do you want <u>to join</u> our club?
She went to the park <u>to walk</u> her dog.
<u>To stay</u> healthy, I exercise every day.
to부정사.x: ③ want의 목적어(명사적) / 나머지는 모두 목적 '~하기 위해' (⑤처럼 문장 앞에 와도 목적!)

to부정사.s: 밑줄 친 부분의 우리말 해석이 어색한 것은?
o: She was excited <u>to see</u> the singer. (그 가수를 봐서)
The book is easy <u>to read</u>. (읽기 위해)
I came home early <u>to see</u> my kids. (보기 위해)
He woke up <u>to find</u> himself famous. (깨어 보니 ~을 알게 되었다)
We went to the store to buy some milk.
To protect herself, she wore a helmet.
He was happy to win the race.
This map is easy to read.
to부정사.x: decide는 to부정사를 목적어로 → decided to post (본문 Goldilocks 문장!)

비인칭 주어 it.q: 밑줄 친 It과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
o: I lost my phone, but I found <u>it</u>.
Look at the cat. <u>It</u> is so cute.
비인칭 주어 it.x: <보기>·③ 명암 · 날씨 → 비인칭 주어 / ①④⑤ 대명사(가리키는 대상 있음) ② 가주어(진주어 to play soccer)

비인칭 주어 it.s: <보기> <u>It</u> is ten kilometers from here to the beach.

o: <u>It</u> is important to keep your promise.
<u>It</u> is a present from my aunt.
I like this song. <u>It</u> makes me happy.
Where is my umbrella? Is <u>it</u> in your bag?
비인칭 주어 it.x: <보기> 거리 · ② 요일 → 비인칭 / ① 가주어 ③④⑤ 대명사

비인칭 주어 it.s: 밑줄 친 it의 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
o: How far is <u>it</u> to the station?
<u>It</u> is easy to make a sandwich.
비인칭 주어 it.x: ④ 진짜 주어(to make a sandwich)를 대신하는 가주어 / 나머지는 계절 · 거리 · 시간 · 날씨 비인칭

비인칭 주어 it.s:
(a) It is Monday today.
(b) It is difficult to learn Chinese.
(c) Look at the dog. It is so big.
(d) It snowed a lot last winter.
(e) It is not easy to wake up early.
비인칭 주어 it.q: 밑줄 친 It의 쓰임이 같은 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?

비인칭 주어 it.s: ①<u>It</u> was getting dark, and ②<u>it</u> started to rain. Goldilocks found a cottage. ③<u>It</u> looked warm and cozy. Soon ④<u>it</u> was midnight.
비인칭 주어 it.x: ③ a cottage를 가리키는 대명사 / ① 명암 ② 날씨 ④ 시간 → 비인칭

비인칭 주어 it.s:
A: What time is ⓐ___ now?
B: ⓑ___ is 7 p.m.
A: Is ⓒ___ a bus stop near here?
B: Yes, there is. ⓓ___ is 5 minutes from here.
비인칭 주어 it.q: 빈칸 ⓐ~ⓓ 중 It(it)이 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
비인칭 주어 it.x: 'Yes, there is'로 답하니 ⓒ는 there / ⓐⓑ 시간 · ⓓ 거리 → 비인칭 it
③ 모자를 가리키는 대명사 / <보기>와 나머지는 명암 · 날씨 · 시간 · 계절 비인칭

수여동사.s:
· Bill sent a letter by me.
· Do you teach the students English?
· Who bought the book him?
· Could you give Mary a call?
· Grandma always tells funny stories us.
수여동사.x:
옳은 것: teach the students English / give Mary a call → 2개
sent a letter to me · bought him the book · tells us funny stories

수여동사.s: 다음 문장을 3형식으로 바꿀 때 쓰이는 전치사가 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
o: He sent his mom a card.
Dad bought me a new bike.
She told us a funny story.
수여동사.x: buy → for (~를 위해 사 주다) / give · send · show · tell → to

o: Can you lend your pen ___ me?
He asked a question ___ the teacher.
수여동사.x: cook → for / lend · send · teach → to / ask → of

수여동사.s:
· He made me a kite. = He made a kite ⓐ___ me.
· Can I ask you a favor? = Can I ask a favor ⓑ___ you?

o: She bought for me a hat.
He showed to us his room.
I'll send you to a letter.
Mom made a cake to me.
수여동사.x:
② pass + 간접목적어 + 직접목적어 (4형식) ✔
① bought me a hat ③ showed us his room ④ send you a letter ⑤ made a cake for me

o: She didn't send Mike an invitation card.
Did he buy a new doll his daughter?
Mr. Kim bought us ice cream.
I showed my report card to Mom.
수여동사.x: buy his daughter a new doll 또는 buy a new doll for his daughter

수여동사.s: 밑줄 친 동사를 괄호 안의 말로 바꿀 때 어법상 어색한 것은?
o: The teacher <u>told</u> us an interesting story. (heard)
I made my mom a cup of coffee.
He sent his favorite singer an email.
We bought a delicious cake for the party.

시간의 접속사.s: ①School starts at eight every morning. ②Before I go to class, I prepare my books. ③After school ends, I will join the sports club. ④Before I will go home, I will check my homework.
시간의 접속사.x: 시간의 부사절은 미래라도 현재 시제 → Before I go home

시간의 접속사.s: <보기> I was sleeping <u>when</u> you called me.
시간의 접속사.q: 밑줄 친 when의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
o: I don't know <u>when</u> he will come.
<u>When</u> I was young, I lived in Busan.

시간의 접속사.s: Mina finished her homework. Then she watched TV.
시간의 접속사.q: 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바르게 바꾼 것은?
o: Mina finished her homework after she watched TV.
Mina watched TV before she finished her homework.
After Mina finished her homework, she watched TV.
When Mina watched TV, she finished her homework.
Mina finished her homework before she watches TV.
시간의 접속사.x: 숙제를 끝낸 후에 TV → After + 먼저 한 일 / ①② 순서가 반대 ⑤ 시제 불일치

o: I'll call you when I will arrive.
After he will finish dinner, he'll go out.
Before she goes to bed, she will read a book.
When I will be free, I'll help you.
We will start after everyone will come.
시간의 접속사.x: 시간의 부사절은 미래라도 현재 시제 → ③ goes ✔ / 나머지는 will을 빼야 해요

시간의 접속사.s:
· She takes a nap ⓐ___ she's tired.
· ⓑ___ you leave, close all the windows.
· He got better ⓒ___ he took the medicine.
시간의 접속사.x: 피곤할 때 낮잠 / 떠나기 전에 창문 닫기 / 약을 먹은 후 나음

시간의 접속사.s: 밑줄 친 before / after가 접속사로 쓰인 것은?
시간의 접속사.x: ④ 뒤에 주어 + 동사(you leave) → 접속사 / 나머지는 뒤에 명사만 → 전치사

시간의 접속사.s: 민호의 저녁: 6시 저녁 식사 → 8시 숙제 → 10시 취침
o: Minho had dinner after he did his homework.
Minho went to bed before he did his homework.
Minho did his homework after he had dinner.
Minho had dinner when he went to bed.

sentences.ko: 나는 촬영 장소 관리자이고, 내 일은 촬영을 위한 완벽한 장소를 찾는 거야.
sentences.html: I'm a location manager, and my job is <u>①</u> perfect places <u>②</u>.
sentences.full: I'm a location manager, and my job is to find perfect places for shooting.

sentences.ko: 나는 이 영화의 촬영 감독인 Peter야. 나는 모든 카메라를 담당하고 있어.
sentences.html: I'm Peter, the director of <u>①</u> for this movie. I'm <u>②</u> all the cameras.
sentences.full: I'm Peter, the director of photography for this movie. I'm in charge of all the cameras.
sentences.tip: director of photography = 촬영 감독 · be in charge of = ~을 담당하다

sentences.ko: 그들의 행복한 순간을 포착하기 위해, 나는 드론을 사용할 거야.
sentences.html: <u>①</u> their happy moments, I'm <u>②</u> use drones.
sentences.full: To capture their happy moments, I'm going to use drones.
sentences.tip: To capture = 목적 '~하기 위해' · be going to + 동사원형

o: trained – took care of – for a long time
trained – take care of – for long time
train – took care – for a long time
trained – took care for – a long time
sentences.full: I trained and took care of Max for a long time.
sentences.tip: 과거 시제를 나란히 (trained · took) · take care of = ~을 돌보다

sentences.ko: Max는 주변에 많은 사람들이 있을 때 가끔 매우 흥분해. 그래서 나는 그를 진정시키기 위해 수신호를 사용해.
sentences.html: Max sometimes gets too <u>①</u> <u>②</u> a lot of people are around. So, I use hand signals <u>③</u> him.
sentences.full: Max sometimes gets too excited when a lot of people are around. So, I use hand signals to calm him.
sentences.tip: 감정을 느끼면 -ed (excited) · when = ~할 때 · to calm = 진정시키기 위해

sentences.ko: 내 일은 촬영이 끝난 후에 시작돼.
sentences.full: My work begins after the shooting is over.
sentences.tip: 시간의 부사절 → 미래 대신 현재 시제 (is over)

sentences.ko: 더 좋은 이야기를 만들기 위해서, 나는 장면의 순서를 바꾸거나 장면 중 일부를 삭제할 수 있어.
sentences.html: <u>①</u> a better story, I can change the <u>②</u> of scenes or <u>③</u> some of them.
sentences.full: To create a better story, I can change the order of scenes or delete some of them.
sentences.tip: To create = 목적 · can + 동사원형 change / delete 나란히

sentences.ko: 나는 현장에서 녹음하는 게 쉽지 않을 때 내 작업실에서 음향 효과를 만들어 내.
sentences.html: I create <u>①</u> in my studio <u>②</u> recording <u>③</u> is not easy.
sentences.full: I create sound effects in my studio when recording on location is not easy.
sentences.tip: sound effects = 음향 효과 · on location = 현장에서

sentences.ko: 처음에 그녀는 일상적인 것들을 게시했지만, 사람들은 그녀에게 많은 좋아요를 주지 않았다.
sentences.html: At first, she <u>①</u> everyday things, but people didn't <u>②</u>.
o: posting – give to her many likes
sentences.full: At first, she posted everyday things, but people didn't give her many likes.

sentences.ko: 하지만 그녀의 팔로워들은 곧 지루해졌다. 그래서 그녀는 더 충격적인 사진들을 게시하기로 결심했다.
sentences.html: Her followers, <u>①</u>, soon got <u>②</u>. So, she decided <u>③</u> more shocking pictures.
sentences.full: Her followers, however, soon got bored. So, she decided to post more shocking pictures.
sentences.tip: however = 그러나 · 사람이 지루함을 느끼면 bored · decide + to부정사

sentences.ko: 날이 어두워지고 있었고, 비가 내리기 시작했다.
sentences.html: <u>①</u> was getting dark, and it started <u>②</u>.
sentences.full: It was getting dark, and it started to rain.
sentences.tip: 명암 · 날씨 → 비인칭 주어 It · start + to부정사(목적어)

sentences.ko: 이제부터 나는 게시 버튼을 누르기 전에 두 번 생각할 거야.
o: From now on – after – will press
In the future – before – will press
sentences.full: From now on, I'll think twice before I press POST.
sentences.tip: from now on = 지금부터 · 시간의 부사절은 현재 시제 (press)

sentences.ko: 그것은 Tom과 그의 개 Max의 우정에 관한 영화야. 많은 사람들이 이 영화를 만들기 위해 열심히 일하고 있어.
sentences.html: It's a movie about the friendship <u>①</u> Tom <u>②</u> his dog Max. A lot of people are working hard <u>③</u> this movie.
sentences.full: It's a movie about the friendship between Tom and his dog Max. A lot of people are working hard to create this movie.
sentences.tip: between A and B = A와 B 사이 · to create = 만들기 위해 (목적)

sentences.ko: 그녀는 다시 셀카를 찍었고 그 셀카들을 모두 소셜 미디어에 올렸다. 그리고 그녀는 위층으로 가서 침대 세 개를 발견했다.
sentences.html: She <u>①</u> again and <u>②</u> all the selfies on social media. Then, she went <u>③</u> and found three beds.
sentences.full: She took selfies again and posted all the selfies on social media. Then, she went upstairs and found three beds.
sentences.tip: 과거 시제 나란히(took · posted) · upstairs는 부사라 to 없이

sentences.ko: 너는 우리 집에 침입해서 우리 허락 없이 이 사진들을 올렸어.
sentences.html: You <u>①</u> our house and posted these pictures <u>②</u> our <u>③</u>.
sentences.full: You broke into our house and posted these pictures without our permission.
sentences.tip: break into = 침입하다 (과거 broke into) · without + 명사(permission)

dialogs.en: What do you want to be in the future?

dialogs.ko: 나는 모든 종류의 스포츠에 관심이 있어.
dialogs.en: I'm interested in all kinds of sports.

dialogs.ko: 응, 나는 노래를 만드는 것에 정말로 관심이 있어.
dialogs.en: Yes, I'm really interested in writing songs.

dialogs.ko: 나는 조종하는 것이 아니라, 비행기를 만드는 것에 관심이 있어.
dialogs.en: I'm interested in making airplanes, not flying.
I want to be an airplane engineer.

dialogs.ko: 너는 이 파스타에 대해 어떻게 생각하니?
dialogs.en: What do you think about this pasta?

dialogs.ko: 나는 그렇게 생각하지 않아. 내 생각에는 너무 짜.
dialogs.en: I don't think so. I think it's too salty.
I didn't know you were interested in black holes.

dialogs.ko: 그리고 전자책은 종이책보다 더 저렴하기도 해.
dialogs.en: And it's also cheaper than the paper book.
